changes.title: Kirk Killing Suspect Confessed and Voiced Regret, Former Partner Says
changes.summary: Tyler Robinson came home on the day of Charlie Kirk’s assassination and anxiously paced the floor, Lance Twiggs told investigators in an interview that was played in court.

changes.title: Charlie Kirk murder suspect said "he wishes he hadn't done it," roommate says
changes.summary: Lance Twiggs said in a recorded interview with a Utah prosecutor that he saw Robinson the day after Charlie Kirk was shot and killed.

changes.title: Prosecutors to play interview with Tyler Robinson's roommate in Charlie Kirk trial
changes.summary: Video of an interview with the roommate of Tyler Robinson, the suspect in the killing of Charlie Kirk, is set to be played in court Thursday. Robinson allegedly confessed to killing Kirk in a conversation with the roommate. CBS News correspondent Carter Evans reports.

changes.title: Details on preliminary hearing in Charlie Kirk murder case
changes.summary: A critical hearing is continuing this week for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing Charlie Kirk. CBS News' Anna Schecter reports.

changes.title: Clips of interview with roommate of Charlie Kirk murder suspect to be played in court
changes.summary: Prosecutors plan to play audio clips of an interview with the roommate of Charlie Kirk's accused killer during a preliminary hearing on Thursday. CBS News legal contributor Caroline Polisi has more details.

changes.title: Suspect's roommate in Charlie Kirk killing given immunity for recorded statements
changes.summary: Prosecutors revealed that the roommate of the man accused of assassinating Charlie Kirk was given "use immunity" in exchange for providing recorded video statements to investigators about the case.
